nodes.name: Trigger: Manual Run
nodes.notes: Press 'Test workflow'. Optionally pin input data with {"test_openai": false} to skip the paid call.

nodes.name: Factory Config
nodes.notes: แก้ค่าตั้งค่าทั้งหมดที่ DEFAULTS ในโค้ดของ node นี้ (ดับเบิลคลิกเข้ามาแก้ได้เลย) รองรับ n8n Cloud - ไม่ต้องใช้ environment variable. Order: parent cfg > Variables > env > defaults.

nodes.name: Check Setup
nodes.notes: Step 1+2. Reports which environment variables are set and whether $env is readable at all. Never throws - it produces a report.

nodes.name: Check: Test OpenAI
nodes.notes: Skips the paid call when env access is broken or test_openai=false.

nodes.name: Build Test Prompt
nodes.notes: The smallest useful request - a mistyped key costs a fraction of a cent.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ systemInstruction: { parts: [{ text: $json.system_prompt }] }, contents: [{ role: 'user', parts: [{ text: $json.user_prompt }] }], generationConfig: { temperature: 0.7, maxOutputTokens: 200, responseMimeType: 'application/json' } }) }}

nodes.name: Gemini: Connection Test
nodes.notes: Uses the OpenAI credential, exactly like the real workflows. Errors are captured, not thrown, so the report still renders.

nodes.name: Parse OpenAI Reply
nodes.notes: Step 3. Checks the key works AND that JSON mode parses - a key that returns prose would break every downstream workflow.

nodes.name: Skip OpenAI Test
nodes.notes: Records why the call was skipped and continues to the PDF test.

nodes.name: Build Test PDF
nodes.notes: Step 4. Same dependency-free PDF writer the product line uses. The file is attached as binary - download it from the output panel.

nodes.name: Build Setup Report
nodes.notes: Four checks with pass/fail and the exact next step.

nodes.name: Setup Test Finished
nodes.notes: Terminal node. Green here means n8n is ready for the real workflows.
